task_text: Fix split_fields(text) in solution.py. Unescaped commas split fields; backslash escapes ONLY comma or backslash; preserve empty fields including trailing ones. Empty input returns ['']. Invalid escape or dangling backslash raises ValueError. No imports or external dependencies. Return full solution.py in files, with only pure functions; allowed built-ins len/range/enumerate/zip/sorted/list/tuple/str/int/float/bool/abs/min/max/sum/round/ValueError; the only allowed method call is list.append. Do not include grading tests. answer may briefly identify the implementation. Host checks run separately. Inputs are strings, at most80 characters.

response.concise_method_summary: Scans characters once, splitting only unescaped commas. A backslash accepts only comma or backslash, preserves empty/trailing fields, and raises ValueError for invalid or dangling escapes.
proposed_verification: Invalid escapes such as 'a\\x' and dangling 'a\\' raise ValueError
